name: fqc-dbt
description: dbt build/test/run + run-status for FQC-ARR, wrapping the local dbt CLI / ARRCloseOrchestrator / dbt Cloud API. dev/qa targets are non-destructive; the prod target carries destructiveHint so Sana always requires approval before any prod run.

securityScheme.note: Sana holds dbt Cloud service token / warehouse creds. Fallback local: dbt profiles + DBT_PROJECT_DIR for eda-dbt-em.

tools.name: build
tools.description: dbt build for selected models (+downstream) on dev/qa. Non-destructive to human systems.

tools.name: test
tools.description: dbt test for selected models / the FQC-ARR test suite (waterfall balance, row parity, currency tie-out) on dev/qa.

tools.name: run
tools.description: dbt run for selected models. On target=prod this is GATED (destructiveHint=true): Sana must show an approval card and no prod run is ever automatic.

annotations.note: destructiveHint applies only when target=prod; dev/qa runs are non-destructive but declared conservatively.

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Read the status of a CD/deploy run (dbt Cloud job run) for cd-monitor. Read-only.

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile a model to inspect resolved SQL / lineage for the debugger. Read-only.
